text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Lands and Valuation Minister Peter Fatch told secondary school teachers sub-letting their servants quarters to tenants that the practice is illegal because their houses because are leased by government.

- Visiting Taiwanese Foreign Minister John Chang told reporters on Monday that his government will donate funds to build houses for Malawi army soldiers currently renting accommodation outside the barracks.

- Opposition Alliance for Democracy (AFORD) president Chakufwa Chihana was on Saturday made church elder in the Church of Central Africa Presbyterian (CCAP) in Rumphi, northern Malawi, amid a controversy threatening to split the church.
- A vehicle belonging to President Bakili Muluzi's brother has been impounded by police in a sweeping exercise by customs officials against those evading payment of duty.
